Sam (Account Exec): FYI — Acme Health sent a compliance questionnaire asking for long audit-log retention, exportable evidence, and EU residency for logs. They specifically call out 7 years retention + signed audit packages. Link: https://acme.health/qna.pdf

Intake Bot: New questionnaire uploaded by Sam: acme_health_qna_2026.pdf

Maya (Product): Thanks Sam. Moving this into product intake. Quick triage Qs: is this a hard legal/regulatory requirement or a customer preference we can negotiate? @Li can you weigh in on HIPAA vs SOC2 implications here? Also we need acceptance criteria to create a backlog ticket.

Li (Legal): Looks mixed. SOC2 itself usually expects evidence of controls and monitoring but not a fixed 7y retention. 7 years is more aligned with healthcare legal/regulatory policies (state law, malpractice records). Important: if PHI is present we must treat this as regulated processing. For EU residency, GDPR requires lawful basis + data processing agreement + careful export controls. Recommend we flag as "legal review required" and ask customer to confirm whether data will include PHI and which jurisdictions apply.

Ravi (Support): Confirmed from convo: Acme is a covered entity and they will send PHI through some ingestion endpoints. They asked for DPA + explicit residency in eu-west-1.

Maya (Product): OK — proposed scope for a backlog epic (initial draft):
- Org-level retention config (default 1y, configurable up to 7y) via API + admin UI
- Exportable audit package (CSV + JSON) with verification metadata (signed by system, timestamped)
- Data residency tag per org (eu-west-1 support) and enforcement for stored logs
- Background GC/archival pipeline and admin export endpoint
- Acceptance criteria + docs for sales/legal to use as interim evidence

Acceptance criteria (proposed):
1) Admin API and UI exist to set retention per org and show applied retention policy.
2) Audit export includes event id, user id (anonymized if requested), action, timestamp, and signature metadata.
3) Export generation completes or provides progress within 24 hours for a 1 year slice.
4) Data residency setting ensures all stored copies are kept only in the selected region (eu-west-1) for the retention period.

Jun (SRE): High-level tech notes: this touches storage (S3 buckets per region), indexing (we keep index for quick export), retention GC job, and export generator service. Also KMS/HSM ties for signing exports. Rough effort: core infra changes + API/UX + export pipeline — likely 6–10 weeks of combined work (split across infra & product teams). Need detailed spec to refine. Also cost delta: storing 7 years of logs increases long-term costs; need ballpark to present to customer.

Sam (Account Exec): To confirm prioritization — Acme is indicating willingness to sign a 12mo contract and commit to an enterprise plan (~$200k ARR) if we can provide residency + retention SLAs. They want to close this quarter. Can we offer any compensating controls in the short term?

Li (Legal): We can provide SOC2 readiness docs and attestations of controls but we cannot provide an actual SOC2 report until a completed audit. Short-term compensating controls: manual exports, signed statements of controls, DPA addendum, and a timeline for feature delivery. Also need to confirm whether 7y retention is legally mandatory for them or negotiable.

Maya (Product): Proposed rollout plan:
- Short-term (2–4 weeks): "Compliance package" deliverable: curated docs + manual export process + signed attestation for sales to use as stopgap.
- Medium-term (8–12 weeks): Backlog epic to implement configurable retention + residency + automated export (ships across a couple of sprints).

Jun (SRE): I can draft a tech spec and break into tickets: infra storage layout, retention GC job, export API, UI bits, KMS signing integration. Estimate: 2.5 FTE for 8 weeks to deliver the medium-term epic. If we prioritize P0 we can compress some work by shipping export as a manual process first.

Maya (Product): Nice. Prioritization ask: if sales can secure the commitment (Sam), we'll mark as P0 in the enterprise backlog. Action items:
- Sam: capture commitment + timeline in CRM and confirm PHI details (is PHI in scope?).
- Li: draft required legal language for DPA addendum and suggested interim attestation wording.
- Jun: open epic in Jira, add rough estimates and dependencies (KMS, multi-region storage).
- Ravi: collect the customer's answered questionnaire and any missing clarifications.

Sam (Account Exec): On it — pinged Acme for PHI confirmation and timeline. Added note to CRM: "Acme: enterprise close if residency+retention delivered or interim package accepted".

Intake Bot: Thread labeled: compliance-intake, priority: enterprise, placeholder ticket created: INF-4382.

Maya (Product): Proposed sync Thurs 10:00 to align on the short-term package and confirm owners. If no objections, I'll convert the draft scope to a formal epic and tag as P0 pending CRM confirmation. :calendar:
